Potassium reacts with iodine to form potassium iodide.
Which statement about potassium iodide is correct?
A
Each potassium atom shares a pair of electrons with an iodine atom.
B
In potassium iodide, the particles of potassium have more protons than electrons.
C
Potassium iodide has a high melting point because it is a covalent compound.
D
Potassium iodide has a low melting point because it is an ionic compound.
